Has anyone tried to build quasicoherent (or quasi-coherent) sheaves on a scheme, say following the Stacks Project definition (tag 01BE)?

This requries imposing the condition that a sheaf is locally a cokernel of a morphism between free modules over the structure sheaf. I was hoping that the free modules could just be constructed as free I X.modules where I : Type and X : Scheme but I must be missing a subtlety here...

Hi Kiran, we have quasicoherent sheaves here: docs#SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent. It is defined similarly to what you describe. There is some ongoing work to show that all quasicoherent sheaves on Spec R are of the form docs#AlgebraicGeometry.tilde for some R-module M
I will need that fact later. Do you have the signature for that proposition by any chance so that I can build on it with the correct call syntax?

import Mathlib
open CategoryTheory
universe u

lemma AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent
    {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (M : (Spec R).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    IsIso M.fromTildeΓ :=
  sorry

The converse is in mathlib (it is available as an instance: docs#AlgebraicGeometry.instIsQuasicoherentOpensCarrierCarrierCommRingCatSpecTilde).
